{{Quote|Identify yourself.|LS-515|<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />}}
'''LS-515''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[scout trooper]] that served the [[Galactic Empire]]. While patrolling an Imperial excavation site centered around the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]], LS-515 and her [[speeder]] wing-mate [[LS-412]] were ambushed by the [[Spectres]] rebel group. The rebels stole the scouts' [[armor]] to use as disguises.

==Biography==
LS-515 was a [[Gender|female]] [[scout trooper]] who was stationed on [[Lothal]] in [[1 BBY]]. She and her wingmate [[LS-412]] were assigned to patrol the perimeter of the [[Excavation of the Lothal Jedi Temple|excavation camp]] outside the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]] on [[614-AvA speeder bike]]s. While on patrol, they stumbled upon a [[Hologram|holographic projection]] of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] from the [[Battle of Atollon]]. LS-515 and LS-412 were then knocked out by the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]], who was a member of the [[Spectres]] rebel cell. As Zeb hit her, her helmet flew off.<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />

The rebels [[Sabine Wren]] and [[Ezra Bridger]] then stole her and LS-412's armor and infiltrated the camp. Despite the rebel impostors' disguises, LS-515 and LS-412's absence did not go unnoticed by the other Imperials. While Sabine and Ezra were trying to unlock the [[Painting of the Mortis gods]], a stormtrooper confronted "LS-515" and asked why she and LS-412 had deviated from their regular patrol. Sabine claimed it was a misunderstanding and offered to go to "Operations" and sort it out. At the [[mobile command center]], the Imperial [[Minister]] [[Veris Hydan]] exposed her as an undercover rebel and placed the camp on lockdown.<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />

==Personality and traits==
LS-515 was a [[Gender|female]] [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> who served as a scout trooper in the Imperial Military. She wore white armor over a black uniform and rode a 614-AvA speeder bike.<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />

==Behind the scenes==
LS-515 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|Season Four]] episode "[[Wolves and a Door]]," which premiered on [[February 26]], [[2018]]. She was voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]], who also voiced the rebel protagonist [[Hera Syndulla]].<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />
